subject: Coord: partner-referred technical walkthrough availability for Retailly
messages:
From: Katie Park <katie@cloudscale.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Meyers <jmeyers@retailly.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Intro — Retailly (Jordan) interested in Redwood walkthrough

Evelyn / Marissa — looping you in. Jordan is a technical buyer at Retailly (cc'd) and is evaluating options for substitutable search and rerank features at scale. We discussed a short technical walkthrough + PoV checklist to validate integration and data flow.

Jordan — Evelyn is our AE who will coordinate a 30–45m technical walkthrough. Would you be able to share 2–3 windows next week that work for you? I can join the call to help cover integration details from the SI side.

Thanks,
Katie Park
Partnerships Lead, CloudScale Integrations
[katie@cloudscale.com]
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jmeyers@retailly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Katie Park <katie@cloudscale.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Retailly (Jordan) interested in Redwood walkthrough

Hi Jordan — great to meet you via email, and thanks Katie.

We'd love to run a focused technical walkthrough: 30–45 minutes, demoing a small index + embeddings pipeline, model selection implications, and a short discussion on integration points (KV cache, prefix caching, and expected latency).

My availability (PST):
- Tue 11/30 10:30–11:15am
- Wed 12/01 9:00–9:45am
- Wed 12/01 2:00–2:45pm

If none of those work, send two windows that do and we'll adjust. Marissa — would you and Katie want to join the walkthrough for the integration Q&A? Dylan (cc'd) will own the calendar invite and technical prep.

Sample agenda attached (one-pager) and a short PoV checklist we usually run through. I can share a quick test dataset if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0189

Thanks for the quick reply — appreciate the agenda. The team here is aiming for a technical run-through that covers: data ingestion (S3->index), latency expectations under 1k qps, and options for private deployment (we're in the EU but US-first infra ok for PoV).

I can do Tue 11/30 10:30am but I just realized I have a conflicting board meeting — apologies. Can we move to Wed 12/01 9:00am PST? That would work best for me. Katie and I will join from the SI side as well.

Jordan

Perfect — thanks for the quick note, Jordan. Wed 12/01 9:00–9:45am PST is confirmed on our side.

I've created the calendar event and attached the one-pager agenda + PoV checklist again for easy reference. Dylan, can you please send the invite (Google Calendar) to everyone and include a short pre-call checklist (credentials, sample dataset link)?

Proposed final agenda (30–40m):
1) 5m quick intros & goals
2) 15m demo: ingestion -> index -> embed -> query path + live latency example
3) 10–15m integration discussion: deployment options, quantization/throughput suggestions
4) 5m next steps & PoV checklist assignment

Thanks — looking forward.

Regards,
Evelyn
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
